purpose: Evaluate the current semantic extraction prompt on 400 new natural short posts with BF16. This is exploratory evaluation, not model training or production acceptance.
required_next_hardware: Single 80GB GPU or two 40GB GPUs splitting one BF16 model; verify runtime, free VRAM, RAM and GPU communication on the actual instance.

batches.name: startup_check
batches.role: existing examples, functional check and initial throughput estimate; no quality gate on borderline clear-position labels

batches.name: natural_evaluation
batches.role: all new natural posts, preserved original sample, 20 per stock

sample.reference_status: unlabeled; review against original text after inference
sample.population_limit: Available unique short texts after historical-experiment exclusions; not all 400k posts.

generation.reasons: preserve per-claim reasons and original evidence
generation.scope: preserve subject,target,time,negation; do not use subsequent price outcomes

controlled_changes.change_for_next_batch: Use BF16 weights and a new natural sample; keep semantic definitions, prompt and score meanings fixed.
controlled_changes.not_identifiable: This alone does not establish BF16 versus INT4 accuracy improvement on matched samples.
controlled_changes.smooth_score_status: Separate feature design still needs calibration; current intensity/support are not exit extent. Do not silently reinterpret them.

prior_gate.decision: Proceed to a separately named exploratory validation requested by user; do not claim old gate passed or use it as production acceptance.
prior_gate.runner_status: Dedicated bf16_exploratory stage added in copied runner; original gate and old runner unchanged.

review.all_400: Inspect original post, evidence, reason and scores; ambiguous cases stay unresolved and outside high-certainty subset. Do not ask user to label all400.
review.priority: Wrong subject/object, negation/completion reversal, invented emotions and missing clear meanings matter more than neighboring labels.
review.newest_80_reference: Assistant provisional reference, not human gold.
material_outputs: Count of usable clear observations vs ambiguous/error rows
Score sensitivity checks without claiming stock-return validation

execution_policy.row_format_errors: Save raw response and continue remaining inputs.
execution_policy.resumption: Checkpoint every completed request; resume only missing IDs with identical prompt/model/input hashes.
execution_policy.paid_deadline: Require explicit session deadline; initial budget is not silently extended.
execution_policy.timing: Previous INT4 80 batch took2537.14 seconds;400 at same throughput would take3.52h. BF16 estimate must come from actual startup/rolling throughput, not asserted faster.
execution_policy.service_error_policy: A malformed or token-limited row continues; three consecutive infrastructure failures stop the queue for diagnosis.

additional_work.optional_old_controls: remaining72 only after400 complete with at least15min remaining

completion.quality_notice: No human gold; fixed-label comparison is not complete semantic utility. See each change with free observations. No stable overall BF16 improvement established.
